---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: fatal-vs-nonfatal-by-activity
attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Activity)) |>
  add_count(Activity, name = "activity_total") |>
  filter(activity_total >= 50, Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(Activity, n, .fun = sum), y = n, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal and Non-fatal Shark Attacks by Activity",
    x = "Activity",
    y = "Number of attacks",
    fill = "Outcome"
  )
```
